description:
The Kitchen Calculator app by MyKitchenCalculator.com is a tool that includes a recipe converter (recipe multiplier), cooking references, and several conversion calculators that help you easily convert between the most common measuring units used in cooking and baking.

The recipe converter tool allows you to scale, multiply, divide, or portion your recipes to the serving size you desire. Easily convert recipes to your desired serving size by typing in (*or copying and pasting*) the ingredients from your favorite online food blogs or recipe sites.

*Note: Due to the nature of text formatting, the copy and paste function may not work directly for some websites and certain mobile browsers.

The ingredient unit converter tool allows you to convert by ingredient between volume and weight units, such as cups and grams. Choose from more than 250 of the most common ingredients, such as butter, eggs, flour, and sugar!

The tool also includes basic conversion calculators for Volume, Weight, Length, Energy, Time, and Temperature. For most conversions, you can directly type in fractions as an input value, such as "1 1/2" or "3/4". The tool also keeps a history of your past conversions.

In addition to conversion calculators, the app has a Gas Mark reference and a cooking temperature references that allows you to quickly look up information about cooking temperatures for meat, candy, and other dishes.

Take the power of recipe conversion with you by downloading this app. MyKitchenCalculator.com, recipe conversion made easier!

Recipe Converter:
Multiply, divide, or portion recipes with ease. This tool will take fraction inputs and output them to the nearest fraction also!

Ingredient Unit Converter:
Convert by ingredient between common volume and weight units for more than 250 ingredients! Includes sticks of butter conversion and conversion of medium, large, and x-large whole eggs!

Volume Converter:
Convert between units of teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons, fluid ounces, milliliters, liters. You can also convert between US and UK (imperial) units. There is also a conversion to "Cups and Spoons". This conversion will convert volume units to denominations of common measuring cups and spoons. For example, 1.75 cups = 1 cup + 3/4 cup.

Weight Converter:
Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Energy Converter:
Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:
View common gas mark settings in Fahrenheit or Celsius.

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:
1)Conversions are calculated approximations and may not be exact.
2)US volume conversions are NIST based rounded values.
3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.
5)This tool is based on rounded and simplified values and is not recommended for mathematical, engineering, or scientific calculations that need precision.

A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.

  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.

name: KnowDrugs Drug Checking
description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

Widgets
Track your habits directly from your home screen, with beautiful and colorful widgets.

Completely ad-free and open source
There are absolutely no advertisements, annoying notifications or intrusive permissions in this app, and there will never be. The complete source code is available under an open-source license (GPLv3).

Works offline and respects your privacy
Loop doesn't require an Internet connection or online account registration. Your confidential habit data never leaves your phone. Neither the developers nor any third-parties have access to it.

Take your data with you

name: Product Management - CraftUp
description:
CraftUp is the product management learning app for product managers, aspiring PMs, founders, designers and developers who want to build better products. It helps you learn product management step by step with short, focused daily lessons you can actually apply in your work and side projects.

If you want to start a product management career, move from junior to mid or senior product manager, or simply make smarter product decisions as a founder, CraftUp gives you a clear, structured path. You learn modern product management, not random tips or outdated theory.

CraftUp is built around real product work. Each lesson focuses on one concrete product management decision: understanding a user problem, validating an idea, designing an MVP, planning a simple experiment, running user interviews, defining product metrics, or deciding what to ship next. You do not just read about product management, you practice product thinking every day.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

With CraftUp you will learn core product management skills, including:

How to find real problems worth solving using user research

How to validate ideas with interviews, surveys and simple experiments

How to design and build MVPs that test the right product assumptions

How to get your first users and grow from zero with limited time and budget

How to use feedback, data and metrics to improve your product

How to understand product market fit and avoid false signals

How to prioritize a roadmap when everything feels important

How to make better product decisions with scarce resources

How to think and communicate like a product manager or founder

This is practical product management training you can use if you are preparing for a PM role, already working as a product manager, or building your own startup.

WHO CRAFTUP IS FOR

CraftUp is designed for:

People starting from zero who want a clear way to learn product management

Aspiring product managers preparing for their first PM job or interview

Junior product managers who want to grow faster and build confidence

Founders and indie hackers who need product management skills to ship smarter

Designers and developers who want to understand product decisions, not just tickets

Professionals in other fields who want to learn product thinking and turn ideas into products

HOW IT WORKS

CraftUp breaks product management into small, guided steps. Lessons are short, structured and focused on one topic at a time. You can complete a lesson in a few minutes, but over time you build deep understanding of how real product management works.

You learn how to frame user problems, write simple hypotheses, design experiments, pick metrics that matter, and make tradeoffs. Many lessons use examples from real products and real product managers so you see how product thinking works in practice, not in theory.

WHY CRAFTUP IS DIFFERENT

CraftUp is not another generic business course or a playlist of long video lectures. It is a dedicated product management learning environment. The content is focused only on product management and product thinking. No fluff, no motivational noise, just clear explanations and concrete actions.

The experience is calm and intentional. You will not find growth hacking tricks or pressure to hustle more. Instead, CraftUp helps you build a consistent learning habit so you actually stick with product management over weeks and months. You get just enough structure to keep moving forward without feeling overwhelmed.

CraftUp is your companion in the messy but rewarding process of learning product management and turning ideas into real products. Whether you want to become a product manager, level up in your current role, or build your own product as a founder, CraftUp gives you the product management skills, mindset and practice you need.

Learn product management. Build better products.

• Total spent and money currently at risk
• Money recovered by returning on time

name: HVAC Airflow CFM Calculator
description:
HVAC Airflow CFM Calculator helps HVAC technicians, engineers, and contractors calculate cubic feet per minute (CFM) airflow with four methods for cross-checking and verification. This air conditioning calculator eliminates guesswork in ductwork design and system diagnostics.

CALCULATION METHODS:
Temperature Delta Method — CFM from BTU load and supply/return temperature difference
Duct Velocity Method — CFM from duct size (round or rectangular) and air velocity (FPM)
Sensible Heat Method — CFM from sensible cooling/heating capacity and temperature delta
Total Heat Method — CFM from total heat load and enthalpy difference

CORE FEATURES:
Round & Rectangular Duct Support — Both duct shapes in velocity calculations
Cross-Check Verification — Use multiple CFM methods to validate calculations
Instant Results — Airflow, velocity, and duct area displayed in real-time
100% Offline Operation — No internet connection required for field calculations

name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.

Web version: calc.ashrae-meteo.info

Llama Life offers a 7-day free trial, with a Monthly or Annual subscription.

Marie

name: Accu​Battery
description:
Accu​Battery displays battery usage information, and measures battery capacity (mAh) based on science.
 
❤ BATTERY HEALTH
 
Batteries have a limited lifespan. Every time you charge your device, it wears out the battery, lowering its total capacity.

- Use our charge alarm to remind you to unplug your charger.
- Discover how much battery wear was endured during your charge session.
 
📊 BATTERY USE
 
Accu​Battery measures the actual battery usage using information from the battery charge controller. Battery usage per app is determined by combining these measurements with information on which app is in the foreground. Android calculates battery usage using pre-baked profiles that device manufacturers provide, like how much power the CPU uses. In practice however, these numbers tend to be highly inaccurate.
 
- Monitor how much battery your device is using
- Know how long you can use your device when it’s active or in standby mode
- Find out how much power each app uses.
- Check how often your device gets woken up from deep sleep.
 
🔌 CHARGE SPEED
 
Use Accu​Battery to find the fastest charger and USB cable for your device. Measure the charging current (in mA) to find out!
 
- Check how fast your device is charging when the screen is on or off.
- Know how long it takes to charge your phone and when it’s finished.
 
HIGHLIGHTS
 
- Measure real battery capacity (in mAh).
- See how much wear your battery sustains with each charge session.
- Look up the discharge speed and battery consumption per app.
- Remaining charge time - know how long it takes before your battery is charged.
- Remaining use time - know when you will run out of battery.
- Screen on or screen off estimations.
- Check the percentage of deep sleep, when the device is in standby mode.
- Ongoing notification for real time battery statistics at a glance.
 
🏆 PRO FEATURES
 
- Use Dark and AMOLED black themes to save energy.
- Access to historical sessions older than 1 day.
- Detailed battery statistics in notification.
- No ads
 
We're a small, independent app developer with a focus on quality and passion for battery statistics. AccuBattery doesn’t require access to privacy-sensitive information and doesn't make false claims. If you like the way we work, support us by upgrading to the Pro version.

Personality traits are relatively stable over time, but they can and often do gradually change as you age.

People who are more extraverted tend to feel energized by social interactions, enjoy meeting and socializing with people, and are often the center of attention. They are often perceived as outgoing, social, full of energy, enthusiastic, and action-oriented.

People who are more introverted tend to feel drained by social interactions, prefer a good amount of solitude, and dislike small talk. They are often perceived as quiet, low-key, and deliberate. They need less stimulation and more time alone than extraverts.

name: Introvert - Be Social
description:
Embracing your inner extrovert might feel like stepping into uncharted territory, but fear not! Becoming more social is an exciting journey that begins with simple steps, gradually leading to newfound confidence and sociability.

Start by taking baby steps into the world of social interactions. Begin with small talk; strike up a conversation with a friendly neighbor, a co-worker, or someone waiting in line. Practice active listening - it's an art that helps you connect more deeply with others.

Challenge yourself to attend social gatherings or events. It might feel daunting at first, but remember, each experience is a chance to grow. Push your comfort zone a little each time. Maybe set a goal to attend one social event a week, or even a month, to start with.

Join clubs or groups that align with your interests. Whether it's a book club, a hiking group, or a cooking class, being around like-minded individuals can make socializing feel more natural and enjoyable.

Practice positive self-talk. Encourage yourself along the way. Acknowledge your progress and celebrate the little victories. Remember, Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither is the confident extrovert version of yourself!

Lastly, be patient and kind to yourself. Transforming into a more social butterfly takes time. Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither will your social prowess. Each step you take, no matter how small, is a stride toward a more confident and outgoing you.

So, get ready to spread your wings and dive into the wonderful world of social interactions. You've got this!

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

Privacy Policy: https://www.askdiem.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.askdiem.com/terms-of-service

name: Allervibe: Food Allergy Scan
description:
Stop guessing in the grocery aisle.

You're standing in front of a shelf, package in hand. The label is in 6-point font. The "may contain" warning is hiding somewhere between the additives and the nutrition table. Your kid has a peanut allergy. You squint. You flip the box. You put it back. You move on.

Allervibe was built for that moment.

Point your camera at the barcode. In about a second, you have your answer: green to eat, yellow for caution, red to avoid. No squinting. No second-guessing. No anxiety in aisle four.

Here is the whole loop:

1. Tell Allervibe once which allergens you avoid, with how strict you are about each.
2. Scan a barcode.
3. We read the ingredients, the allergen declarations, and the trace warnings, then match them against your profile.
4. You get a clear verdict, plus the full ingredient list and a breakdown of every additive used.

That is it. No account. No sync. No waiting.

Allervibe covers the 13 most common food allergens: peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, soy, wheat, gluten, sesame, shellfish, fish, sulphites, mustard, and celery. Behind the scenes we use Open Food Facts, the world's largest open database of food products, with millions of entries from over 100 countries. Coverage in your local supermarket gets better every week.

Built for:

• Parents reading every label twice for their kids
• Anyone with celiac disease, gluten intolerance, or a wheat allergy
• People managing lactose intolerance or dairy sensitivities
• Adults with nut, peanut, sesame, or shellfish allergies
• Households balancing multiple dietary needs in one shopping trip
• Vegans and vegetarians spotting hidden animal ingredients
• Travellers reading labels in foreign supermarkets

Allervibe is free to use, every day. The free version covers daily scans, your personal allergen profile, and full detection across all 13 allergens. No ads. Ever.

Allervibe Pro unlocks:

• Unlimited daily scans
• Your full scan history with search
• Favorites for products you have already cleared
• Family profiles, so each person in the household has their own allergen list
• A detailed additives breakdown with E-numbers and common names

A profile for every member of your family? That was the whole point. One person is celiac. Another is dairy-free. A third reacts to nuts. With family profiles in Allervibe Pro you switch between them with a tap before you scan, and everyone gets the answer that matters to them.

Allervibe lives on your device. Your allergen profiles, your scan history, and your favorites stay private. We do not sell your data. We do not share what you scan. We do not require an account or a sign-in.

Currently available in English and German, with French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, and Russian on the way.

A note on safety. Allervibe is an informational tool, not a medical device. Always read the packaging before you eat. If you have a severe or life-threatening allergy, do not rely on the app alone. Read the label, follow your doctor's guidance, and carry your prescribed medication. Data accuracy depends on Open Food Facts, which is community-edited and may be incomplete.

name: Allergy Lens: AI Food Scanner
description:
Tired of reading tiny ingredient lists or guessing what is safe to eat at a restaurant? Allergy Lens is an AI-powered menu scanner designed to help you identify food allergens and read complex labels.

Unlike traditional apps, we operate as a visual label reader with no barcode needed. Simply take a photo with your camera, and our AI vision technology will help you spot potential sources of gluten, dairy, and other specific allergens based on your personal profile.

🚦 Visual Alert System
Our visual system is designed to provide quick insights to help you make informed decisions:

Green: No allergens detected based on your profile.

Yellow: Warns of possible cross-contamination or unclear ingredients.

Red: Highlights explicitly detected allergens to avoid.
Our AI is trained to help identify obscure industrial names and derivatives to assist users managing severe dietary restrictions.

✨ Core Features:

📸 Visual Menu & Label Scanning: Break free from limited barcode databases. Scan physical restaurant menus, fresh bakery items, and foreign labels directly with your camera.

🧠 AI Vision Technology: Powered by visual language models to read, process, and understand complex food contexts and ingredient nomenclatures.

🌍 Travel Assistant: Traveling abroad? The app helps translate and interpret restaurant menus in multiple languages, assisting you with your dietary needs without language barriers.

👨‍👩‍👧 Multi-Diet Profiles: Set up multiple restrictions on a single device. Scan a product to check compatibility for different dietary profiles simultaneously (e.g., gluten-free, vegan, and specific allergies).

⚠️ IMPORTANT AI & MEDICAL DISCLAIMER:
Allergy Lens uses Artificial Intelligence to analyze text and images. While we strive for high accuracy, AI technology can occasionally make mistakes, misinterpret text, or miss hidden context. This app is designed as an assistive tool only and is NOT a replacement for professional medical advice, your own judgment, or direct communication with restaurant staff/manufacturers. Always double-check labels and consult directly with food providers, especially if you have severe or life-threatening allergies (anaphylaxis). Relying solely on this app is at your own risk.

Take control of your dietary choices. Set up your personalized allergy profile today and let Allergy Lens assist you in navigating menus and ingredient lists.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality

➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.

➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts


➜ Milk, Gluten, Eggs, Soybeans, Nuts, Fish, Celery, Mustard, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites, Peanuts, Sesame seeds, Crustaceans, Molluscs or Lupin allergy ?
➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.
➜ Be careful that the information may not be 100% accurate, and detection may not be 100% accurate. So always double check by yourself, with the packaging.

💰 Open Prices: Transparency on Food Costs


- Contribute to Price Transparency. When you shop, add the price on the shelf, or at home, add the receipt. Let's track shrinkflation, cheapflation & more.

name: Food For You: Your Food Diary
description:
Food For You is the easiest way to eat well without spreadsheets, barcode hunts or guesswork. Snap a meal and the AI logs the calories, protein, fat and carbs straight into your diary. Point your camera at a food label and get a health score, allergen flags and a plain-language breakdown of every additive. One app does the diary and the scanner.

YOUR DAILY PLAN, BUILT FOR YOU
Tell the AI your age, weight, activity and goal (lose, maintain or gain). It calculates your daily calorie target and splits it into protein, fat and carbs using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula. Don't agree with a number? Edit any value with a tap.

SNAP A MEAL, LOG THE MACROS
Photograph any plate (homemade, restaurant or packaged) and the AI identifies the dish, estimates the portion and writes calories and macros into your diary. Adjust by hand if you want, or just trust the photo. Your diary fills itself, breakfast through snack.

LABEL SCANNER THAT GOES DEEPER
Point your camera at any food label and get a 0-100 health score built from NOVA and Nutri-Score, an Eco-Score for the planet, a Glycemic Index reading and every additive decoded in plain English. Know what's really in the box before it hits your cart.

ALLERGEN ALERTS, 60+ TRIGGERS
Set your allergy profile once: nuts, gluten, dairy, soy, shellfish and 60+ more. Every scan and diary entry is checked against it. Unsafe ingredients get flagged before you take a bite.

PERSONAL DIET PROFILES
Pick how you eat and the AI factors it into every result:
• Halal (new), vegan, vegetarian
• Keto, paleo, Mediterranean
• Gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free
• Low-sodium, low-sugar, heart-healthy

DAILY PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
A calorie ring, macro bars and a meal-by-meal view show how breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks stack up against your target. Streaks, XP, levels and small daily challenges make it easy to stay consistent.

COMPARE TWO PRODUCTS
Two yogurts? Two cereals? Scan both, see them side by side, pick the one that actually fits your goals.

YOUR HISTORY, ALWAYS YOURS
Search past scans, scroll past diary days and watch the patterns shift over weeks and months.

FREE PLAN

• Last 10 scans saved
• Last 7 diary days kept

PREMIUM, 7-DAY FREE TRIAL
• Unlimited scans and compares
• Full scan and diary history, kept forever
• AI macro logging on every meal
• Cancel any time

WHY PEOPLE PICK FOOD FOR YOU
• Real AI analysis on every photo, not a static barcode database
• Diary and scanner together: calories, macros, allergens, additives in one place
• Targets calculated from your body and your goal, not a generic preset
• Halal support plus 60+ allergens, useful for families with mixed diets
• 10 languages with full right-to-left Arabic
• Privacy-first. Your data stays yours, never sold
• No ads, ever

Download Food For You and let the AI handle the math while you focus on eating well.
